text: Acceptance 13/10: the REST path the served /skill.md calls "the reliable path for any agent; start here" (line 26) documents no route for thread reply (threadId), ask (POST /api/conversations/:id/ask), answer (POST /api/questions/:id/answer), leases (POST /api/leases, /leases/release), join, or the PUT /api/wake body. Repro: grep -c threadId|/ask|/api/leases|/join on /skill.md -> 0 each; I found them only in src/http/routes/*.ts. Fix: a REST block per route + the /ask shape {question:<number>}.
